title: Paraguay — Active Cadastral Parcels
description:
Active cadastral parcels (*parcelas activas*) for Paraguay: 2,192,890 polygons.

**There is no unique identifier column.** `padron` holds 46,963 distinct values across 2,192,890 rows, and even `dpto` with `dist` and `padron` gives only 814,114 distinct combinations. `ccatastral`, which encodes the same three values as one string, gives 1,107,044. Treat every parcel key here as non-unique.

Attributes include department (`dpto`), district (`dist`), padrón number (`padron`), zone (`zona`), block (`mz`), lot (`lote`), holding (`finca`), registry number (`nro_matricula`), cadastral code (`ccatastral`), area in hectares (`hectareas`), land and building surface (`superficie_tierra`, `superficie_edificado`) and land and building value (`valor_tierra`, `valor_edificado`).

`obs` is uncontrolled free text carried over from the source registry. 886,763 rows are not blank. The same text repeats as the last pipe-delimited field of `clave_comparacion` in 822,579 rows, so a filter on `obs` alone does not remove it.
